name: Kajun Faycott
original_name: カジュン＝ファイコット
source:
Kajun Faycott is one of the main characters of the Remix Heart and the Variable Heart manga, of the two Remix Heart Gaiden side-stories in Chrono Phantasma Extend and also appears in Central Fiction. She was a classmate and friend of Noel Vermillion, Tsubaki Yayoi, Makoto Nanaya and Mai Natsume during their time at the Military Academy. Though she acted like a normal student, in reality she was an undercover agent from Sector Seven that was sent by Kokonoe to obtain the Burning Red Grimoire. She recruited Mai to work for Kokonoe after they left the academy.

Kajun acts like an eccentric but refined young lady, though she also likes to tease her friends. She is also rather manipulative as she will encourage her friends to pursue actions that further her mission while concealing her true motive. Nonetheless she cares for them and will try to encourage and help them. Kajun is very intelligent and loves collecting data and analyzing events and people around her.
